fund_nav_data_revisions: CHECK (maintenance_run_id IS NULL OR mutation_kind = 'UPDATE'::text AND NOT data_changed AND calendar_changed)
CHECK (source_run_id IS NULL OR maintenance_run_id IS NULL)
fund_nav_feature_evidence: FOREIGN KEY (risk_run_id, instrument_id) REFERENCES fund_nav_risk_run_members(risk_run_id, instrument_id)
fund_nav_readiness_current: FOREIGN KEY (run_id, state) REFERENCES fund_nav_readiness_runs(run_id, state)
fund_nav_readiness_runs: CHECK (as_of_session = window_end AND window_start < window_end AND latest_closed_session >= as_of_session)

CHECK (state = 'building'::text AND completed_at IS NULL AND published_rows IS NULL OR state = 'complete'::text AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND published_rows = expected_rows AND run_fingerprint IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (policy_id, policy_version) REFERENCES nav_policy_versions(policy_id, policy_version)
fund_nav_readiness_v1:
CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN admissible THEN COALESCE(reason_code IS NULL AND is_active IS TRUE AND fund_status = 'ACTIVE'::text AND valuation_frequency = 'daily'::text AND is_current AND interval_compatible AND missed_due_sessions = 0 AND missing_session_count = 0 AND observed_levels_count = 401 AND admissible_returns_count = 400 AND return_semantics = 'observed_interval_log_ratio'::text AND identity_verified AND return_basis_verified AND currency_verified AND lifecycle_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND ingestion_run_id IS NOT NULL AND risk_run_id IS NOT NULL AND feature_evidence_id IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(feature_evidence_id)) > 0 AND risk_input_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND input_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND calendar_equivalence_digest IS NOT NULL AND risk_input_max_date IS NOT NULL AND feature_as_of IS NOT NULL AND risk_input_max_date = window_end AND feature_as_of = window_end, false)
    ELSE reason_code IS NOT NULL
END)
fund_nav_risk_exclusions: FOREIGN KEY (risk_run_id, instrument_id) REFERENCES fund_nav_risk_run_members(risk_run_id, instrument_id)
fund_nav_risk_publication: CHECK (state = 'running'::text AND active_risk_run_id IS NOT NULL OR state = 'idle'::text AND active_risk_run_id IS NULL)
fund_nav_risk_runs: CHECK (run_scope = 'current_full'::text AND nonpublishing_reason IS NULL AND policy_id IS NOT NULL AND due_session IS NOT NULL AND calc_date = due_session AND requested_limit IS NULL OR run_scope = 'diagnostic'::text AND nonpublishing_reason IS NOT NULL)

CHECK (status = 'running'::text AND completed_at IS NULL AND persisted_rows IS NULL OR status = 'metrics_complete'::text AND completed_at IS NULL AND persisted_rows = expected_rows OR status = 'complete'::text AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND persisted_rows = expected_rows)
FOREIGN KEY (policy_id, policy_version) REFERENCES nav_policy_versions(policy_id, policy_version)
nav_calendar_maintenance_runs: CHECK (array_ndims(instrument_ids) = 1 AND cardinality(instrument_ids) >= 1 AND cardinality(instrument_ids) <= 20 AND nav_uuid_array_unique_v1(instrument_ids))

CHECK (status = 'running'::text AND completed_at IS NULL AND changed_rows IS NULL AND after_digest IS NULL OR status = 'completed'::text AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND changed_rows IS NOT NULL AND after_digest IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (policy_id, policy_version) REFERENCES nav_policy_versions(policy_id, policy_version)
nav_ingestion_attempts: CHECK (finished_at IS NULL OR attempted_at IS NULL OR finished_at >= attempted_at)
nav_instrument_policy_evidence: FOREIGN KEY (policy_id, policy_version) REFERENCES nav_policy_versions(policy_id, policy_version)
nav_policy_current: FOREIGN KEY (policy_id, policy_version) REFERENCES nav_policy_versions(policy_id, policy_version)

views.fund_nav_readiness_current_v1:
SELECT r.run_id,
    r.instrument_id,
    r.readiness_profile,
    r.readiness_version,
    r.policy_id,
    r.policy_version,
    r.policy_hash,
    r.calendar_id,
    r.calendar_version,
    r.window_start,
    r.window_end,
    r.as_of_session,
    r.fund_status,
    r.is_active,
    r.status_known_at,
    r.status_effective_at,
    r.lifecycle_evidence_id,
    r.valuation_frequency,
    r.last_nav,
    r.nav_last_date,
    r.first_nav,
    r.last_usable_return_end,
    r.is_current,
    r.missed_due_sessions,
    r.missing_session_count,
    r.observed_levels_count,
    r.observed_endpoint_count,
    r.admissible_returns_count,
    r.observed_return_count,
    r.interval_compatible,
    r.return_semantics,
    r.identity_verified,
    r.return_basis_verified,
    r.currency_verified,
    r.ingestion_run_id,
    r.feature_evidence_id,
    r.risk_run_id,
    r.risk_input_fingerprint,
    r.nav_revision_id,
    r.risk_input_max_date,
    r.feature_as_of,
    r.cohort,
    r.admissible,
    r.ready,
    r.reason_code,
    r.input_fingerprint,
    r.evidence_digest,
    r.sample_id,
    r.calendar_equivalence_digest,
    p.published_at AS pointer_published_at,
    run.decision_at,
    run.completed_at,
    run.run_fingerprint,
    run.latest_closed_session,
    run.risk_publication_revision,
    due.session_date AS latest_due_session,
    fund_nav_snapshot_current_at_v1(r.instrument_id, run.run_id, clock_timestamp()) AS snapshot_current
   FROM fund_nav_readiness_current p
     JOIN fund_nav_readiness_runs run ON run.run_id = p.run_id
     JOIN fund_nav_readiness_v1 r ON r.run_id = run.run_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.session_date
           FROM nav_valuation_schedules s
          WHERE s.calendar_id::text = run.calendar_id::text AND s.calendar_version::text = run.calendar_version::text AND s.nav_due_at <= clock_timestamp()
          ORDER BY s.session_date DESC
         LIMIT 1) due ON true
  WHERE p.readiness_profile = 'current_daily_nav_v1'::text AND run.state = 'complete'::text;
